name: Emoji & Icon Studio by Kairesh
releaseNotes:
v2.1.0 Update: Complete Studio Fix & Enhancements!
• 200,000+ vector icons stream smoothly via high-speed Node network
• Fixed After Effects SVG outline creation (pure vector shape layers)
• All icon libraries (Lucide, Phosphor, Tabler, Heroicons, Brand Logos) render crisply with zero broken images
• Fully interactive settings drawer with customizable insert size, API configs, and asset storage
• In-app automatic update manager with Skip and Remind Later options.
